viewport.label: Simulation
viewport.sceneLabel: 3D view of the {{model}} model. Drag to rotate, scroll to zoom.
viewport.miss: The blow misses the head at this offset.

punchSpeed.label: Punch speed
punchSpeed.description: How fast the fist is moving when it hits.

guard.label: Guard
guard.description: How much of the blow is absorbed by blocking.

impactPolar.label: Polar angle
impactPolar.description: Where the blow comes from, measured down from the top of the head: 0° is the top, 90° is level, 180° is from below.

impactAzimuth.label: Azimuth
impactAzimuth.description: Where the blow comes from, around the head: 0° is the front, 90° the left side, 180° the back, 270° the right side.

offset.label: Off-center offset
offset.description: How far the blow passes from the center of the head. Off-center blows also twist the head.

offsetDirection.label: Offset direction
offsetDirection.description: Which way the blow is shifted off-center: 0° sideways (like a hook), 90° upward, 270° downward.

fistMass.label: Effective fist mass
fistMass.description: Mass of the fist and arm that takes part in the impact.

shearModulus.label: Stiffness
shearModulus.description: Resistance to shape change. Softer tissue deforms more.

viscosity.label: Viscosity
viscosity.description: Internal friction. Higher values damp the wave faster.

density.label: Density
density.description: Mass per volume of the tissue.

layers.label: Tissue layers
layers.description: Number of concentric layers the brain is divided into.

resolution.label: Mesh resolution
resolution.description: Points per layer. Higher is more detailed but slower.
